items.informal_name: Linear Independence of Polynomial Sequence Basis
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (S : Polynomial.Sequence R) [IsDomain R], LinearIndependent R ↑S
items.informal_description: The family of monomials in the sequence representation of polynomials forms a linearly independent set in the module structure over the semiring $ R $. Specifically, no non-trivial linear combination of these monomials with coefficients in $ R $ yields the zero polynomial.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence Under Addition of Zero Scalar Multiple
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : ι → M} {c : ι → R} {i : ι}, c i = 0 → (LinearIndependent R (v + fun x => c x • v i) ↔ LinearIndependent R v)
items.informal_description: If the coefficient $c_i$ is zero, then the linear independence of the vector family $v + (c_j \cdot v_i)_{j \in \iota}$ is equivalent to the linear independence of the original family $v$. In symbols, $\mathrm{LinearIndependent}(R, v + (c \cdot \bullet v_i)) \leftrightarrow \mathrm{LinearIndependent}(R, v)$ when $c_i = 0$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence of Extended Family with Vector Not in Span
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {m : ℕ} (x : M)
  (v : Fin m → M),
  LinearIndependent R v →
    (∀ (c : R) (y : ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))), c • x + ↑y = 0 → c = 0) → LinearIndependent R (Fin.cons x v)
items.informal_description: If a vector $x$ is not in the span of a linearly independent family $v : 	ext{Fin}(m) 	o M$, then the family obtained by prepending $x$ to $v$ remains linearly independent over the semiring $R$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence of $\{x + b \cdot y, y\}$ iff $\{x, y\}$ is Linearly Independent
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {x y : M} {S : Type u_6}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [inst_5 : Module S R] [inst_6 : Module S M] [SMulCommClass S R M]
  [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R] (b : S),
  LinearIndependent R ![x + b • y, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
items.informal_description: The set of vectors $\{x + b \cdot y, y\}$ is linearly independent over the ring $R$ if and only if the set $\{x, y\}$ is linearly independent over $R$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence Under Addition of Zero Scalar Multiple
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : ι → M} {c : ι → R} {i : ι}, c i = 0 → (LinearIndependent R (v + fun x => c x • v i) ↔ LinearIndependent R v)
items.informal_description: If the coefficient $c_i$ is zero, then the linear independence of the vector family $v + (c_j \cdot v_i)_{j \in \iota}$ is equivalent to the linear independence of the original family $v$. In symbols, $\mathrm{LinearIndependent}(R, v + (c \cdot \bullet v_i)) \leftrightarrow \mathrm{LinearIndependent}(R, v)$ when $c_i = 0$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence of $\{x + b \cdot y, y\}$ iff $\{x, y\}$ is Linearly Independent
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {x y : M} {S : Type u_6}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [inst_5 : Module S R] [inst_6 : Module S M] [SMulCommClass S R M]
  [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R] (b : S),
  LinearIndependent R ![x + b • y, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
items.informal_description: The set of vectors $\{x + b \cdot y, y\}$ is linearly independent over the ring $R$ if and only if the set $\{x, y\}$ is linearly independent over $R$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence Equivalence for [x + y, y] and [x, y]
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {x y : M},
  LinearIndependent R ![x + y, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
items.informal_description: The family of vectors $[x + y, y]$ is linearly independent over a ring $R$ if and only if the family $[x, y]$ is linearly independent over $R$.

items.informal_name: Equivalence of Linear Independence for Pairs with a Right Sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {x y : M},
  LinearIndependent R ![x, x + y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
items.informal_description: The pair of vectors $x$ and $x + y$ is linearly independent over a ring $R$ if and only if the pair $x$ and $y$ is linearly independent over $R$.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence Preserved by Insertion of Non-Span Element
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] {s : Set ι} {i : ι},
  LinearIndepOn R v s → (∀ (r : R), r • v i ∈ Submodule.span R (v '' s) → r = 0) → LinearIndepOn R v (insert i s)
items.informal_description: If a family of vectors $ v $ is linearly independent on a set $ S $, and the vector $ v(i) $ is not in the span of $ v(S) $, then the family remains linearly independent after inserting $ i $ into $ S $. Formally, if $ \forall r \in R, r \cdot v(i) \in \operatorname{span}(v(S)) \Rightarrow r = 0 $, then $ v $ is linearly independent on $ S \cup \{i\} $.

items.informal_name: Linear Independence of $\{x, c x + y\}$ iff $\{x, y\}$ is Linearly Independent
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {x y : M} {S : Type u_6}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [inst_5 : Module S R] [inst_6 : Module S M] [SMulCommClass S R M]
  [IsScalarTower S R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree S R] (c : S),
  LinearIndependent R ![x, c • x + y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
items.informal_description: For a ring $R$, the set $\{x, c x + y\}$ is linearly independent over $R$ if and only if the set $\{x, y\}$ is linearly independent over $R$.

items.name: linearIndependent_iff''
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : ι → M},
  LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R), (∀ i ∉ s, g i = 0) → ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ (i : ι), g i = 0

items.type:

  [inst_2 : Module R M] {v : ι → M},
  ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∃ f ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s, (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f = 0 ∧ f ≠ 0
